children: ICICI Securities research report on Amagi Media Labs

Amagi is a tech enabler for the M&E industry – an industry that lagged the tech adoption curve and is now waking up to that reality. As traditional broadcast media globally struggles with moderating top-line growth, management’s focus is shifting toward bottom-line optimisation. Amagi’s core solutions help its clients to save 30-50% of costs through cloud migration vs on-premise infrastructure. Also, AI-enabled products are starting to gain traction which have material savings potential through ad optimisation and improving efficiency of content curation/reframing. Amagi’s NRR of >125% implies >25% YoY revenue growth without client addition.
We think its ability to stay ahead of the tech curve is underlined by the fact that 55% of its workforce is engaged in R&D. We initiate with a BUY rating and a TP INR 700.
